copy.validate: When a skill doesn't help, that's information. It isn't proof you can't do this.
copy.settle_first: Things feel loud right now. You could ground yourself first.
copy.body_title: Could your body be turning the volume up?
copy.body_note: Like running on little sleep, feeling ill, not eating regularly, or something you took.
copy.fix_body: When your body is running low, feelings can get louder and skills have less to work with. Looking after one of those counts as a skill too.
copy.fit_title: Did the feeling fit the facts?
copy.fit_hint: Some skills are for feelings that fit what happened, some for feelings that are bigger than it.
copy.fix_fit: When a feeling fits, the move is usually the situation, or making room for the feeling.
copy.fix_fit_unsure: Checking the facts first can show which kind of skill fits.
copy.way_title: Did you do it all the way, or partly, while still protecting yourself?
copy.way_hint: Like going to the party, then staying in the kitchen.
copy.fix_way: That makes sense: protecting yourself is what the feeling pushes for. A smaller step, done all the way, can help more than a big one done partly.
copy.env_title: Is something around you rewarding the old way?
copy.env_hint: Feelings tend to stick around when they get us something.
copy.fix_env: Then the old way is doing a job for you, and the skill is up against it. You could look for another way to get what the old way gets you.
copy.will_title: Were you willing, or was part of you not up for it that day?
copy.fix_will: That's human. Willingness comes and goes. Making room for the part that isn't up for it can come first.
copy.much_title: Was there too much going on at once?
copy.fix_much: When a lot is going on, one skill can get buried. Picking one thing to start with can help.
copy.belief_title: Is a belief getting in the way?
copy.belief_hint: Beliefs about feelings can make a skill feel pointless before it starts.
copy.fix_belief: Beliefs like that can feel like facts. They're beliefs, and you can look at them.
copy.fix_belief_heavy: That sounds heavy to carry. After trying this much, it makes sense to feel it. You don't have to hold it alone.
copy.none: Nothing stood out this time. That's information too. Skills can take a few goes, and that isn't on you.
copy.again_q: Want a nudge to try it again?
